checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: consolidation quality

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 8.9% vs its 20-SMA, 18.9% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The Y check is a hard FAIL — this would be the fourth breakout of a 53-session, 44% move, and the chart confirms three prior visible pushes out of consolidations since late July, making the trend clearly mature. The signal bar itself is honest (close near high, real range expansion, volume doubled), and the 3-session base is tight and orderly, but the repeated-push pattern is the single most decisive visual flaw. Prior breakouts in this move worked only 1 of 4 times, reinforcing the trend-maturity concern.
claude.key_risk: A fourth breakout attempt in a mature 50-session trend with a poor recent follow-through record (1 of 4 prior breakouts closed higher three sessions later) sharply limits the probability of a sustained burst.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal close of 29.38 by more than 1%, or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior base high near 29.20.
